name: Chimpjar Accessibility Toolbar
author: chimpjar

sections.description:
Chimpjar Accessibility Toolbar is a powerful, fully customizable interactive web accessibility toolbar designed to improve website usability for people with disabilities, elderly users, and those with temporary limitations.

🌟 Why Choose Accessibility Toolbar?

  • 35+ Accessibility Features – Comprehensive toolkit for maximum accessibility
  • Easy to Use – One-click activation with intuitive interface
  • Fully Customizable – Match your brand colors and preferences
  • No Coding Required – Simple WordPress admin panel configuration
  • Lightweight & Fast – Optimized code with minimal performance impact
  • WCAG 2.1 AA Compliant – Built following accessibility standards
  • GDPR Ready – No cookies without consent, privacy-focused

🎯 Who Can Benefit?

  • Visually Impaired Users – High contrast, magnifier, text scaling
  • Color Blind Individuals – 3 types of color blindness simulations
  • Dyslexic Users – Specialized font and text spacing
  • Motor Impaired Users – Virtual keyboard, focus indicators
  • Elderly Users – Big cursor, easy navigation
  • Temporary Limitations – Reading mask, distraction-free mode

✨ Key Features

Visual Adjustments

  • Increase/Decrease text size
  • High contrast and dark mode
  • Color blindness compensation
  • Monochrome mode
  • Saturation control

Reading Assistance

  • Dyslexia-friendly font
  • Text spacing and alignment
  • Reading mask and guide
  • Line height adjustment
  • Dictionary lookup

Navigation Tools

  • Page navigation menu
  • Virtual keyboard
  • Focus highlighting
  • Big cursor option
  • Magnifier glass

Content Control

  • Hide images
  • Stop animations
  • Mute sounds
  • Hide distractions
  • Highlight links and headers

Smart Features

  • Auto alt-text generation
  • Custom color schemes
  • Accessibility statement
  • 24-hour temporary hide
  • Position adjustment

🔧 Easy Installation

  1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through ‘Plugins’ menu
  3. Go to Accessibility Toolbar settings page
  4. Customize colors, features, and position
  5. Save settings – toolbar appears instantly!

📱 Fully Responsive

Works perfectly on all devices – desktop, tablet, and mobile phones. The toolbar automatically adjusts its position and size for optimal user experience.

🌍 Translation Ready

Chimpjar Accessibility Toolbar is fully translation-ready and supports standard localization, making it easy to translate all admin and frontend text strings into any language.

🎨 Customization Options

  • Theme Color – Match your brand identity
  • Icon Color – Choose any color for the toolbar icon
  • Icon Size – Adjust from 16px to 40px
  • Bold Icons – Make icons thicker for better visibility
  • Widget Position – Choose from 4 corners of the screen
  • Feature Toggle – Enable/disable individual accessibility tools

🚀 Performance Optimized

  • Lazy loading of resources
  • Non-blocking script execution
  • Minimal CSS footprint
  • No jQuery dependency
  • Built with vanilla JavaScript

🔒 Secure & Reliable

  • Regular security audits
  • WordPress coding standards
  • Input validation and sanitization
  • Output escaping throughout
  • Capability-based access control

External services

This plugin relies on the following third-party service:

  • Wikipedia REST API
    • Purpose: Used to fetch word definitions and article summaries when users use the built-in “Dictionary” lookup feature within the accessibility toolbar.
    • Data Sent: Only the selected search word/text and language code are sent to Wikipedia’s REST API endpoint when the user actively searches or looks up a term. No personal user data or cookies are transmitted.
    • Service Provider: Wikimedia Foundation, Inc.
    • Terms of Use: Wikimedia Terms of Use
    • Privacy Policy: Wikimedia Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “Chimpjar Accessibility Toolbar”
  4. Click “Install Now” then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  4. Click “Activate Plugin”

FTP Installation

  1. Extract the ZIP file
  2. Upload the chimpjar-accessibility-toolbar folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Activate the plugin through WordPress admin

After Activation

  1. Go to Accessibility Toolbar menu in WordPress admin sidebar
  2. Configure your settings:
    • Choose theme color
    • Select icon color and size
    • Pick widget position
    • Enable/disable features
    • Customize accessibility statement
  3. Click Save Configuration
  4. The toolbar will automatically appear on your website!
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with any WordPress theme?

Yes! Accessibility Toolbar is built to work with all properly coded WordPress themes. It uses non-intrusive methods that won’t conflict with your existing design.

Will this affect my website speed?

Minimally. The plugin is optimized for performance with minified assets and conditional loading.

Is this plugin GDPR compliant?

Yes. The plugin doesn’t set any tracking cookies. User preferences are stored locally in the browser’s localStorage, not on your server.

Can I customize which features appear in the toolbar?

Absolutely! The settings panel allows you to enable or disable each feature individually.

Does it work with page builders?

Yes, it works seamlessly with all major page builders including Elementor, Beaver Builder, Divi, WPBakery, and Gutenberg.

Can I position the toolbar manually?

Yes! Use the position selector in settings to choose between bottom-right, bottom-left, top-right, or top-left corner placement.
